title: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive — June 2016–2025, Pietermaritzburg (-29.6168, 30.3928)
claims: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive for the grid cell at 29.6168 S, 30.3928 E, elevation 636 m, over the 300 June days from 2016 to 2025: mean daily maximum 22.1 °C and mean daily minimum 7.7 °C.
The same query gives mean precipitation of 0.4 mm per day; 25 of the 300 June days (8.3%) had at least 1 mm.
These are reanalysis statistics for the Pietermaritzburg grid cell, not official race data and not measurements from the race route.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直接查询 Open-Meteo archive API，取 2016–2025 年 6 月共 300 天，按 daily time 过滤 06 月后计算均值；坐标与海拔取自 Open-Meteo geocoding 的 Pietermaritzburg 条目。

claimVerification.note: API 返回 300 个 6 月日值；temperature_2m_max 均值 22.1，temperature_2m_min 均值 7.7。
precipitation_sum 均值 0.4 mm/day；≥1 mm 的日数 25/300 = 8.3%。
网格再分析数据，非赛事官方观测；Pietermaritzburg 海拔 636 m，不能代表赛道全程。
